description: An outmatched soldier holding formation sets its blade against a giant that steps into reach: a narrow thrust in front (line telegraph, 4 m) once the giant's capsule comes within 3 m of the soldier (ai_max_range_m 3.0 + the giant's radius). Blockable and parryable; 35 damage to a stage-2 giant with armour 0. A giant striking from the edge of its own reach never triggers it (plan sections 3.13, 4.4).
